correctness_confidence.basis: All main theorems, quantifiers, boundary cases (including s_rho < 1, c_tau = 0 with p_tau > 0, and finite-time vs. asymptotic rank behavior), exact rational identities, SOS discriminants (4*d6*d4 - d5^2 and 4*c4*c2 - c3^2), and GKSL canonical-gauge derivations verify cleanly under independent audit.

rigor.basis: Arbitrary-D proofs in Sections 2-5 are self-contained and mathematically tight (Fenchel-Moreau biconjugation, Sion minimax with Slater strong duality and simultaneous congruence diagonalization, exact single-pole tangent bounds for S_m, Euler beta/Mellin identities, and exact operator-algebraic resolvent dissipation), complemented by zero-import Lean 4.36.0 and exact-Q/Q[i] verification of the algebraic and finite-dimensional cores.

novelty.basis: Explicitly framed as a sequel to de Leon [1] and companion paper [2] (ARR-2026-2T3GNZ9H5K8N2V4G), which already established the resolvent criterion and -3/50 Eq. (64) refutation; this sequel contributes substantial original results beyond [1, 2], including quadratic-ball Fenchel-Moreau duality, infinite order dimension and finite-monotone impossibility in D >= 3, tensor dilation convolution with simultaneous catalytic/2-copy super-activation vs. D = 2 no-activation, and the GKSL normal form, SOS resolvent dissipation identity, and rank-non-decrease barrier.

significance.basis: Resolves the remaining structural, order-theoretic, catalytic/multi-copy, and continuous-time Markovian open problems of quantum-state texture across all finite dimensions D >= 2, and transfers verbatim to all rank-1 pure fixed-point quantum resource theories (including zero-temperature Gibbs-preserving thermodynamics); high impact within quantum resource theories, though specialized in scope.

reproducibility.basis: PDF explicitly cites public GitHub repository https://github.com/lluiseriksson/paper146-quantum-texture-barriers at tag v1.0.3 and deterministic MANIFEST_SHA256 = 4d1e4c7477c8ee2503d318e9b7870d49716218b914d13a78f653ab6b08b7658b, with 20 zero-import Lean 4.36.0 theorems, an AST-audited zero-float Python Q/Q[i] verifier, and 60 adversarial tests; slightly short of 5 because the 16 individual C01-C16 SHA-256 digests are not printed in Table 2 and the Lean formalization covers algebraic/SOS/combinatorial cores rather than the full arbitrary-D analytic machinery.

summary: Building explicitly on de Leon [1] and companion paper [2] (ARR-2026-2T3GNZ9H5K8N2V4G), this manuscript resolves four major structural and dynamical problems in quantum-state texture (QST) across all finite dimensions D >= 2: (1) Fenchel-Moreau duality between the Schur-resolvent criterion and constrained quadratic-ball dominance F_sigma(r) >= F_rho(r), a self-contained Sion minimax + Slater + simultaneous congruence diagonalization proof, Stieltjes spectral-measure classification of free equivalence, and a two-line unification of D = 2 and Corollaries 7-9; (2) a sharp jump in order dimension from 2 (D = 2) to infinity (D >= 3) via an explicit full-rank rational single-pole tangent realization of the standard example S_m, ruling out any finite complete set of even discontinuous monotones for D >= 3; (3) multiplicative dilation convolution for R_{rho tensor tau}(mu), Mellin-transform recovery of additive Petz Renyi monotones D_alpha(f1 || rho) for alpha in [0, 2], sharp D = 2 no-activation (for all n >= 1 and catalysts with p_tau > 0), and an explicit full-rank rational D >= 3 witness exhibiting simultaneous qubit-catalytic and 2-copy super-activation with exact SOS certificates; and (4) complete GKSL fixed-point characterization, canonical gauge, exact filter semigroup T_t = e^{tG}, grand-sum preservation criterion, exact SOS resolvent dissipation identity, and a sharp Markovian rank-non-decrease barrier separating finite-time Markovian dynamics from complete reset, measure-and-prepare channels, and mixed-to-pure conversions.
strengths: Self-contained, elementary, and fully verified proof of (3) => (1) in Theorem 1 combining Sion's minimax theorem, Slater strong duality, epsilon-regularization, and simultaneous congruence diagonalization without external SDP black boxes.

Explicit, exact rational-entry construction of the standard example S_m in Theorem 2 for arbitrary D >= 3 and m >= 1 with clean uniform lower bounds (eq. 17) proving dim_ord = infinity and ruling out finite complete monotone sets even without continuity.

Exact multiplicative tensor convolution identity (18), Mellin inversion to Petz Renyi divergences (19)-(20), sharp D = 2 no-activation proof (including the p_tau > 0, c_tau = 0 boundary case), and an explicit rational D >= 3 witness (21) with exact primitive integer SOS certificates (Table 1) for simultaneous qubit-catalytic and 2-copy super-activation.

Complete resolution of QST-free Lindbladian dynamics in Theorem 4: exact gauge transformation eliminating |f1> from jump and Hamiltonian operators, closed-form filter generator G, exact non-negative SOS resolvent dissipation identity (27), and sharp rank-non-decrease barrier (28) separating Markovian semigroups from measure-and-prepare and mixed-to-pure channels.

Transparent delineation in Section 6 between the arbitrary-D analytic proofs (Sections 2-5) and the machine-checked Lean 4.36.0 algebraic/SOS/combinatorial/D=2-GKSL cores, accompanied by a tagged GitHub release (v1.0.3) and deterministic MANIFEST_SHA256.
weaknesses: Explicitly a sequel to [1, 2]: the scalar resolvent equivalence (1) <=> (2) <=> (3) in Theorem 1 and the exact -3/50 refutation of de Leon's Eq. (64) were already established in companion paper [2] (ARR-2026-2T3GNZ9H5K8N2V4G).

In Theorem 4(4) (p. 12-13), the parenthetical extension to 'any integrable time-dependent CP-divisible Lindbladian L_t' omits the explicit 'QST-free' qualifier needed for the filter block T(t) in the Liouville determinant argument to be defined.
Table 2 summarizes certificates C01-C16 and Section 6 prints the aggregate MANIFEST_SHA256, but the 16 individual certificate SHA-256 hashes are not printed in the PDF itself.

The Abstract's phrasing 'four exact theorems backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems' could be misread by a casual reader as full Lean formalization of the arbitrary-D analytic theorems (Sion minimax, matrix exponentials, Mellin integrals), whereas Section 6 clarifies that Lean covers the finite/algebraic/SOS/combinatorial cores (with zero external imports).
potential_errors: Minor quantifier omission on p. 12-13: in Theorem 4(4) and its proof, the parenthetical extension '(and even by any integrable time-dependent CP-divisible Lindbladian)' relies on T(t) being well-defined via det T(t) = exp(int_0^t Tr G(s) ds), which implicitly requires L_t to be QST-free (L_t(f1) = 0 a.e.).
strong_novelty_candidates: Quadratic-ball Fenchel-Moreau duality (Theorem 1(4)) and Stieltjes spectral-measure classification of QST free-equivalence classes (Corollary 1(a)).

Sharp dimensional phase transition dim_ord = 2 (D = 2) vs. dim_ord = infinity (D >= 3) via explicit rational single-pole tangent realization of S_m and finite-monotone no-go theorem (Theorem 2, Corollary 2).

Multiplicative dilation convolution for R_{rho tensor tau}(mu), Petz Renyi Mellin recovery (alpha in [0, 2]), sharp D = 2 no-activation, and explicit full-rank rational D >= 3 witness of simultaneous qubit-catalytic and 2-copy super-activation (Theorem 3).

GKSL QST-free canonical gauge, exact filter semigroup T_t = e^{tG}, exact SOS resolvent dissipation identity (27), and sharp Markovian rank-non-decrease barrier separating Markovian semigroups from measure-and-prepare and mixed-to-pure QST conversions (Theorem 4).
